reviews.title: Very disappointing Decision
reviews.text: 360 Quranic was one of the best apps for learning and understanding the Quran-e-Pak word by word. It is extremely disappointing that this important feature has now been put behind a paywall. The app promotes itself as Sadaqah Jariyah, yet an essential Quran-learning resource is no longer freely accessible. I understand charging for premium extras, but basic Quran learning should remain accessible to everyone. I sincerely hope you reconsider this decision.

reviews.title: Worst Ads Policy
reviews.text:
The app has excellent features and valuable Islamic content, but the ads policy is unacceptable. Ads appear on almost every tap and page, completely disrupting Quran reading and reflection. Users are clearly being forced to buy the ad-free version, which is very expensive and unaffordable for most people.
This level of greed is disappointing, especially for a Quran app. Some ads are inappropriate and clearly not monitored. Turning Quran recitation into an ad-waiting experience is disrespectful and distracting.
If revenue is the only goal, this approach is shameful. Please immediately review and reduce your ads policy. A Quran app should bring peace, not frustration.

reviews.title: Disgusting and awkward app
reviews.text:
Turning the recitation of the Quran into a backdrop for advertising is not just disrespectful, it is a violation of something sacred. Anyone who builds such an app and still chooses to push ads in the middle of Allah’s words should ask themselves what kind of heart remains unmoved by the sanctity of the Quran. This is the Book that softened the hearts of the hardest men, yet they managed to silence that reverence for the sake of a few pennies.
It takes a frightening level of spiritual blindness to let greed override honour for the speech of Allah. The developers may think this is just business, but they should understand that disrespecting the Quran is not a small matter. It stains the soul. It exposes a hollowness inside that no technology can hide.
If there is any trace of faith left in them, they should feel shame pressing on their chest and repent for allowing something so sacred to be treated so cheaply.
